title: Out-of-Bounds Grant Index (last_gnt Offset Error)
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [NO_GNT] gnt=4'h0 every cycle; no master ever granted
rtl: assign gnt = 4'h1 << (last_gnt + 4);  // Shifts out of [3:0] range — always 0
expected_root_cause: The shift amount (last_gnt + 4) always places the one-hot grant bit in positions [7:4], which are outside the 4-bit gnt[3:0] vector; all shifted bits are truncated and gnt evaluates to 4'h0 every cycle.
description: The grant vector is driven as `1 << (last_gnt + 4)` instead of `1 << last_gnt`, shifting all grants 4 positions out of the 4-bit gnt vector — always producing 4'h0.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [NO_GNT] gnt=4'h0 every cycle; no master ever granted
success_log: gnt correctly one-hot: gnt[last_gnt] is high each arbitration cycle.
